acceptedMediumFindings.reason: Zero self-Vault ERC20 shares rejects a non-member. This is a membership predicate, not a target balance of BNB or an external token that unsolicited transfers can disturb.

Exactly 100 pool shares identifies the sole holder entitled to the integer surplus remainder. PoolFunds uses the identical condition for settlement and claimable liability; removing it would omit an existing liability.

receiveNative intentionally uses account for bookkeeping, the platform-fee transfer and Harvested event. Its four return amounts are summaries, not a success flag. Any revert propagates and rolls back the native sale.

The function explicitly returns the complete RewardAccounting.account tuple. Slither 0.11.5 retains tuple-element lvalues despite the direct tuple return; rewards regressions check the returned amounts.

The current-branch PoolVault._harvest explicitly returns the complete FirstoSale.harvest tuple at lines 225-227. This is the tuple-return detector limitation; its fingerprint and Vault source hash are independent of the target-owner candidate.
